instructionsForTomorrow: When Zion Cloud Solutions delivers the official SIS/CRM data dictionary, update the `zionOfficialField` and `zionTable` properties below (or paste the CSV/JSON into the Workbench 'Zion Field Mapper' modal) to automatically re-label all 10 persona A2UI tables.

SOPHIA.plainLanguage: Augustana University's general education curriculum required of all undergraduates (Exploring the Liberal Arts).

i18n.zh: SOPHIA 核心通识教育计划

DFW Rate.plainLanguage: Percentage of enrolled students who earn a D, earn an F, or withdraw (W) from a course rather than completing it with C- or better.

i18n.es: Tasa DFW (% de Baja, Reprobación o Retiro)
i18n.zh: DFW 率（低分/不及格/退课比例）

SAP.plainLanguage: Federal and institutional requirement (minimum GPA and credit completion pace) needed to keep financial aid and scholarships.

i18n.es: Progreso Académico Satisfactorio (Requisito de Ayuda Financiera)
i18n.zh: 学业进展合格标准（维持奖助学金要求）
i18n.ne: सन्तोषजनक शैक्षिक प्रगति (छात्रवृत्ति कायम राख्ने नियम)

Hold.plainLanguage: A block on your account (such as an unpaid balance, missing immunization form, or required advisor check-in) that must be cleared before you can register for classes.

i18n.es: Retención de Matrícula (Bloqueo temporal para inscribir clases)
i18n.zh: 选课限制/冻结（需先解除才能选课）
i18n.ne: दर्ता रोक्का (कक्षा दर्ता गर्नुअघि हटाउनुपर्ने अवरोध)
i18n.am: የምዝገባ እገዳ (ኮርስ ከመመዝገብዎ በፊት መፈታት ያለበት)

F-1 Full-Time Load.plainLanguage: US SEVIS immigration rule requiring F-1 international undergraduate students to stay enrolled in at least 12 credits each fall/spring semester unless authorized by the International Programs Office (IPO).

i18n.es: Carga Completa F-1 (Mínimo 12 créditos para visa internacional)
i18n.zh: F-1 国际学生全职学分要求（每学期至少 12 学分）
i18n.ne: F-1 अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय पूर्ण-समय क्रेडिट (कम्तीमा १२ क्रेडिट आवश्यक)
i18n.am: የF-1 ዓለም አቀፍ ተማሪ ሙሉ ጊዜ ትምህርት (ቢያንስ 12 ክሬዲት)

Prerequisite Override.plainLanguage: Official permission from a faculty member or department chair allowing a student to enroll in a class without having completed the standard prior course.

i18n.es: Exención de Prerrequisito (Permiso especial para inscribir un curso)
i18n.zh: 先修课豁免许可（系主任/教师特批选课）
i18n.ne: पूर्वशर्त छुट अनुमति (विशेष अनुमतिले कक्षा लिने)
i18n.am: የቅድመ-ሁኔታ ይሁንታ (ያለ ቅድመ ኮርስ ለመመዝገብ የሚሰጥ ፈቃድ)

Residency Requirement.plainLanguage: The minimum number of credit hours (particularly upper-level credits) that must be taken directly at Augustana University rather than transferred from another college.

i18n.es: Requisito de Créditos en Residencia (Créditos cursados en Augustana)
i18n.zh: 本校修读学分要求（必须在奥古斯塔纳大学修满的学分）
i18n.ne: संस्थागत रेसिडेन्सी क्रेडिट (अगस्टानामा नै पढ्नुपर्ने क्रेडिट)

fields.label: Student Name
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Student's preferred display name and pronouns.

fields.label: School / Divisional Area
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Augustana School, College, or Arts & Sciences Divisional Area.

fields.label: Department
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Home academic department at Augustana University.

fields.label: Declared Major / Program
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Primary undergraduate or graduate degree program.

fields.label: Primary Faculty / Success Advisor
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Assigned Augustana mentor who guides course planning and degree progress.

fields.label: Earned Credits (of 124)
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Total credit hours earned toward the 124-credit Augustana bachelor's degree.

fields.label: Current Term Credits
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Credits enrolled this semester (12+ required for full-time aid & F-1 international status).

fields.label: SOPHIA Gen-Ed Fulfillment
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Progress on Augustana's SOPHIA Core general education categories.

fields.label: Active Holds
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Account flags (Advising, Financial, Immunization) that block course registration.

fields.label: Academic Standing & SAP
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Good Standing, Academic Warning, or Probation + Financial Aid Satisfactory Academic Progress.

fields.label: Early Warning Indicators
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Attendance, midterm grade < C, or LMS engagement alerts raised by faculty.

fields.label: International / F-1 Credit Guardrail
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Monitors 12-credit SEVIS full-time requirement and reduced course load (RCL) authorization.

fields.label: Accessibility & Modality Prefs
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Screen-reader compatibility, ASL/captioning, Braille/large-print materials, or testing accommodations.
